scope: named-property ASCII field guard and reserved spelling dispatch
adaptation: Accept exactly ASCII letters, digits, underscore and dollar via two u64 masks, with an equivalent wrapping-subtraction lowercase fast path. Reject non-ASCII UTF-16 units before modulo-64 shifts. Validate every unit before rejecting pinned reserved spellings through length/first-unit dispatch; empty names remain accepted. After the matching reserved-length bucket is exhausted, return accepted without testing disjoint lengths. This original checked guard rejects unsupported munging rather than porting upstream code; provenance does not establish execution.
guard-location: Named instance access must not mistake raw source names for munged fields.
